parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface. It has a diameter of about 20 cm.
parts.Functional_description: The sphere displays the map of the world and can rotate around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the supporting structure of the globe, made of plastic, consisting of a circular base and an arm that holds the sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the rotating sphere, keeping it upright and balanced.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use.
